title: Deer Avenger 4 Remaster / Reslopified
author: Nice-Positive-8512
selftext:
I am working on a GODOT based remaster / reslopified version of the game you can see my progress to date

[Deer Avenger 4 Remastered / RESLOPIFIED](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0QZagCvtpFw&lc=UgzKtY61QU7Ny2mvcCt4AaABAg)

  
This is my extremely experimental slopified remake and remaster of 2001s Deer Avenger 4 : The Redneck Strike back.  
  
As a child I loved this game, and given the opportunities given by technology decided to do my sloppy remake of it in GODOT.  
  
My ultimate goal is to recreate a classic 1:1 recreation of the game, but also expand with a remastered lense by adding new maps, enemies equipment, vehicles and more.  
  
Disclaimer the reverse engineering effort and design heavily relies on AI.  
I've also used various textures and assets from sketchfab and polyhaven. Credits will be shared if the project ever becomes public.
